mapper.insert: insert into ums_emp (username, password, avatar, phone, wechat, email, gender, age, province, address, realname, idcard, fk_dept_id, info, hiredate) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{avatar}, #{phone}, #{wechat}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{province}, #{address}, #{realname}, #{idcard}, #{fkDeptId}, #{info}, #{hiredate})
mapper.update:
update ums_emp
username = #{username}, password = #{password}, avatar = #{avatar}, phone = #{phone}, wechat = #{wechat}, email = #{email}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, province = #{province}, address = #{address}, realname = #{realname}, idcard = #{idcard}, fk_dept_id = #{fkDeptId}, info = #{info}, hiredate = #{hiredate}, version = version + 1, updated = current_timestamp
where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select * from ums_emp where id = #{id} and deleted = 0

select * from ums_emp
username like concat('%', #{username}, '%')
and realname like concat('%', #{realname}, '%')
and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and fk_dept_id = #{fkDeptId}
and deleted = 0
select * from ums_emp where (username = #{param1} or phone = #{param1}) and password = #{param2} and deleted = 0
